column1: # Content manifest for the standard cloud briefs (#199): kind<TAB>version<TAB>body hash, one row per
# version a brief has shipped. The hash is `tail -n +2 K.md | git hash-object --stdin` (the body below
# the version line). Append-only: a changed body needs a higher version and a new row; old rows stay so
# a version string is never reused for different content. brief-versions.bats enforces it and prints
# the row to append. See README.md here.
